name: 68845 · Kearney, NE
findings: ZIP 68845 (Kearney) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68845 (Kearney) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68845 (Kearney) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
